name: Isometric Manufacture Sheet
description: Projects every body of the open design to a true isometric, removes hidden lines with a depth buffer, and writes a dimensioned ANSI B manufacture sheet as SVG: title block, bill of materials, parameter table, notes and overall dimensions.

body_names.title: Bodies
body_names.description: Body names to draw, comma-separated. Empty: every body in the design. A dynamic body picker needs SolidCraft plugin-form support (issue #16274).

tolerance.title: Chord tolerance (mm)
tolerance.description: Mesh chord tolerance used for the view and its hidden-line mask.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Sheet scale. Auto picks the largest standard scale that fits the sheet.

date.title: Date
date.description: Sheet date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty: today's date (UTC).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Notes printed on the sheet, separated by ';'. Empty: none.

output.title: Write SVG to
output.description: SVG file name, or a folder path ending in / or \, inside the folder granted to the plugin (grant: output). Empty: return the SVG in the result. A Browse button needs SolidCraft plugin-form support (issue #16274).

inline.title: Return the SVG in the result
